subject: Draft MAP: Traffic replay & load test scheduling for PayFlow
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@payflow.com>, Alicia Turner <ops+replay@payflow.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP: Traffic replay & load test scheduling for PayFlow

Thanks again for a great discovery call this morning — appreciate the clear breakdown of your objectives. Per our agreement, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan that focuses on the load/perf milestone we discussed (traffic replay + peak QPS validation).

High-level ask: confirm the replay window and the peak QPS so we can size dedicated capacity and lock a reservation for your run. Below is the proposed milestone summary for this MAP item. Please mark any edits directly in the attached doc or reply inline.

MAP milestone (Load/Performance Test) — proposed:
- Objective: Validate PayFlow checkout path under realistic peak load using traffic replay and traffic shaping.
- Target close date: 2026-07-21 (goal: complete test and produce perf report)
- Redwood responsibilities: provide replay harness, dedicate a reserved GPU pool (estimated), runtime tuning, collect KV cache/latency traces, deliver perf report.
- PayFlow responsibilities: provide replay manifest (CSV with sample ids, timestamps), confirm peak QPS and user session profile, approve test windows (two candidate slots), validate data retention/PII filters.
- Dependencies: replay manifest delivery, a signed Security Addendum (we have skeleton in the MAP), and a designated ops contact for coordination.

Proposed capacity sizing notes (initial estimate):
- Based on the ballpark numbers you shared on the call (approx 30k total transactions/hour at peak -> sustained peak ~8 QPS with spiky bursts to 50 QPS), we estimate a reserved pool of 2 x A100-equivalent workers for a short 2–4 hour burst run. This is a conservative starting point; Vivek and team will confirm with microbenchmarks.

Proposed test windows (pick two):
- Option A: Tue, 2026-07-20 01:00–05:00 UTC
- Option B: Wed, 2026-07-21 22:00–02:00 UTC

Attachments: redwood_map_draft_20260712.docx (MAP draft), replay_config_example.json (Redwood replay config), payflow_replay_manifest.csv (sample template).

Next steps: Please reply with: 1) preferred test window, 2) confirmed peak QPS and burst profile, 3) who will be the PayFlow ops point-of-contact during the run.

Thanks — I’ll loop in procurement/Security if the signed addendum is needed before the run.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@payflow.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Turner <ops+replay@payflow.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 10:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Traffic replay & load test scheduling for PayFlow

Thanks Neha — solid summary. A few clarifications from the PayFlow side: we can provide the replay manifest by EOD Monday (2026-07-13).

Confirmed numbers:
- Baseline traffic: ~30k tx/hr across checkouts (global), our US region peak: sustained ~18 QPS for ~15 minutes, with short spikes to ~120 QPS during promos.
- Sample size: we expect to replay ~45k events for the full window; we can trim to a 4-hour contiguous slice if that makes sizing easier.

Preferred window: Option B (Wed, 2026-07-21 22:00–02:00 UTC) works best for our ops team — less customer impact.

Ops contact: Alicia Turner (ops+replay@payflow.com) will own the run and be on-call for troubleshooting. She’s copied here.

Note on redaction: our replay manifest will contain masked PII fields; we will flag any payloads that must be filtered. We’ll include a short doc in the CSV describing the redaction choices.

Jordan
Jordan Ellis
Senior Product Manager, PayFlow
j.ellis@payflow.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@payflow.com>, Alicia Turner <ops+replay@payflow.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Traffic replay & load test scheduling for PayFlow

Thanks — moving this to action. A couple of technical notes from the infra side that will affect capacity/reservation planning:

1) QPS & burst handling: Jordan’s spike number (120 QPS) is the critical driver. For traffic-replay we need to provision headroom for token expansion and KV cache warming. Practically, I’d plan for ~1.8x multiplier on peak for short bursts. That implies planning for ~220 QPS equivalent load during the hottest minutes.

2) Worker sizing: to hit 220 QPS for your model candidate (decoder-only, 8k context) we estimate needing a pool of 4 mid-to-large GPUs (A100-class) with continuous batching disabled for the spike window, or 2x larger GPUs with network concurrency tuning. We’ll provide an exact node/slot recommendation after we run a 30-minute microbenchmark with a sanitized replay sample.

3) Scheduling & reserved capacity: to guarantee the window we’ll need confirmation and a deposit for short-term reserved capacity by EOD Tue 2026-07-14. If PayFlow prefers to run on shared capacity we can still execute but cannot guarantee latency SLOs during the spike.

Action items for Redwood:
- I will run a microbenchmark once we have the sample slice (Vivek) — target Tue 2026-07-14 morning PT.
- Prepare capacity reservation quote (Marissa) — will send pricing/commit options by EOD 2026-07-13.

Action items for PayFlow:
- Deliver sanitized replay manifest (Jordan/Alicia) by EOD Mon 2026-07-13.
- Confirm payment/commit preference for capacity reservation by EOD Tue 2026-07-14.

Marissa — can you prepare the short reservation quote (2 options: conservative 4-GPU pool for guaranteed SLOs vs. opportunistic shared-run with no SLO)?

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@payflow.com>, Alicia Turner <ops+replay@payflow.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 15:22:03 -0700
Subject: RE: Draft MAP: Traffic replay & load test scheduling for PayFlow

Perfect — thanks all for the fast turnaround. Quick recap and commitments so the MAP reflects what we agreed: 

Confirmed items to lock into the MAP:
- Test window: Wed, 2026-07-21 22:00–02:00 UTC (Option B) — PayFlow ops lead: Alicia Turner.
- Replay manifest: PayFlow to deliver sanitized CSV by EOD Mon 2026-07-13 (Jordan/Alicia).
- Microbenchmark: Vivek to run a 30-minute microbenchmark Tue 2026-07-14 morning PT using a small sanitized slice.
- Capacity: Redwood to deliver a reservation quote (Marissa) with two options; PayFlow to confirm by EOD Tue 2026-07-14 to hold guaranteed capacity. If PayFlow chooses not to reserve, Redwood can run on shared capacity but without guaranteed SLOs.
- Target close for milestone: 2026-07-21 (perf report delivered within 48 hrs after run).

I’ve updated the attached MAP (redwood_map_draft_20260712.docx) with these date/owner changes and a single-line Risk register entry for redaction/PII handling. Marissa — can you add the reservation quote and include a short note on billing cadence (one-off vs. committed monthly)?

Jordan/Alicia — if you confirm the manifest delivery timing and payment preference by EOD Tue, I’ll mark the milestone as "Committed" in the MAP and create the HubSpot milestone update.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

P.S. I’ll drop the DocuSign link for the Security Addendum in the HubSpot milestone once Marissa confirms the quote.
